name: Dan Boneh
biography: heads the applied crypto group at the Computer Science department at Stanford University. Dr. Boneh's research focuses on applications of cryptography to computer security. He is a recipient of the Packard Award, the Alfred P. Sloan Award, and the RSA Award.
